daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿أَلَمْ تَرَ﴾ the hamza is a particle of affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī), and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, the sign of its jussive being the omission of the weak letter from its end, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun, mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause stands in place of the two objects of ترى. ﴿بِأَصْحابِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْفِيلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ﴾ the hamza is a particle of affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī), and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) by lam, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَيْدَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي تَضْلِيلٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَأَرْسَلَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿طَيْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿أَبابِيلَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿تَرْمِيهِمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿بِحِجارَةٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of حجارة; the clause is a second adjective of طيرا.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿فَجَعَلَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir). ﴿كَعَصْفٍ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the two are in the position of the second object. ﴿مَأْكُولٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of عصف; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.
